dct_title_s: Papua New Guinea - Earthquake on Jan 26 2026
dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000s4jy](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000s4jy) Magnitude 5.6 earthquake at 8.197 depth occurred on Jan 26 2026 6km E of Pimaga. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -6.5004 longitude 143.5648. It impacted 266259 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
